name: Keep asynchronous flows async and cancellation-aware
statement: Return Task or ValueTask from asynchronous operations, await work instead of blocking on it, propagate CancellationToken through I/O and long-running orchestration, and reserve async void for event handlers.
rationale: Review runs and repository scans are concurrent, cancellable operations. Sync-over-async risks deadlocks and thread starvation, while dropped cancellation wastes work after callers leave.

badExample.description: A request path blocks on asynchronous work

goodExample.description: The path remains asynchronous and propagates cancellation

history.change: Initial async-hygiene rule grounded in Quality Studio review, sensor, API, and persistence flows.
